* **Column E**: `Type` (e.g., `WEDDING`, `SECOND`)
* **Column F**: `Details` (e.g., `"wedding second shoot..."`)
```excel
=COUNTIFS(
  ARRAYFORMULA(REGEXMATCH(D2:D, "(?i)June|July|Aug")), TRUE,
  ARRAYFORMULA(REGEXMATCH(E2:E & " " & F2:F, "(?i)wedding")), TRUE
)

```excel

  REGEXMATCH(D2:D, "(?i)June|July|Aug"), 
  REGEXMATCH(E2:E & " " & F2:F, "(?i)wedding")
